description: This file contains a test fixture implementation for SbPlayer, including classes and methods for managing media samples, handling player states, and interacting with media buffers in a testing environment.

classes.name: SbPlayerTestFixture::GroupedSamplesIterator
classes.description: Iterator class for traversing grouped media samples, managing current position and advancing through audio and video samples.

methods.name: AddAudioSamples
methods.description: Adds an audio sample descriptor to the grouped samples with optional timestamp and discard durations.

methods.name: AddAudioEOS
methods.description: Adds an end-of-stream marker for audio samples.

methods.name: AddVideoSamples
methods.description: Adds a video sample descriptor to the grouped samples.

methods.name: AddVideoEOS
methods.description: Adds an end-of-stream marker for video samples.

methods.name: CallbackEvent
methods.description: Represents callback events for decoder and player state changes, used in event queue processing.

methods.name: SbPlayerTestFixture
methods.description: Test fixture class for managing SbPlayer testing, including setup, teardown, and media buffer operations.

methods.name: Seek
methods.description: Performs a seek operation to a specified media timestamp.

methods.name: Write
methods.description: Writes grouped media samples to the player, handling end-of-stream and sample data.

methods.name: WaitForPlayerPresenting
methods.description: Waits until the player reaches the presenting state.

methods.name: WaitForPlayerEndOfStream
methods.description: Waits until the player reaches the end-of-stream state.

methods.name: GetCurrentMediaTime
methods.description: Retrieves the current media timestamp from the player info.

methods.name: SetAudioWriteDuration
methods.description: Sets the duration for which audio data can be written.

methods.name: GetAudioSampleTimestamp
methods.description: Gets the timestamp of a specific audio buffer.

methods.name: ConvertDurationToAudioBufferCount
methods.description: Converts a media duration to the number of audio buffers.

methods.name: ConvertDurationToVideoBufferCount
methods.description: Converts a media duration to the number of video buffers.

methods.name: DecoderStatusCallback
methods.description: Static callback for decoder state changes.

methods.name: PlayerStatusCallback
methods.description: Static callback for player state changes.

methods.name: ErrorCallback
methods.description: Static callback for error events.

methods.name: OnDecoderState
methods.description: Handles decoder state change events.

methods.name: OnPlayerState
methods.description: Handles player state change events.

methods.name: OnError
methods.description: Handles error events and logs error messages.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the player and DRM system, sets up media codecs and sample info.

methods.name: TearDown
methods.description: Cleans up resources, destroys player and DRM system, and verifies cleanup.

methods.name: CanWriteMoreAudioData
methods.description: Checks if more audio data can be written based on current state and duration limits.

methods.name: CanWriteMoreVideoData
methods.description: Checks if more video data can be written.

methods.name: WriteAudioSamples
methods.description: Writes specified audio samples to the player.

methods.name: WriteVideoSamples
methods.description: Writes specified video samples to the player.

methods.name: WriteEndOfStream
methods.description: Signals end of stream for specified media type.

methods.name: WaitAndProcessNextEvent
methods.description: Waits for and processes the next callback event within a timeout.

methods.name: WaitForDecoderStateNeedsData
methods.description: Waits until the decoder needs more data or timeout occurs.

methods.name: WaitForPlayerState
methods.description: Waits until the player reaches a desired state or timeout occurs.

methods.name: GetDecodeTargetWhenSupported
methods.description: Retrieves the current decode target if supported.

methods.name: AssertPlayerStateIsValid
methods.description: Validates the sequence of player states received.
